name: Long coprimality gaps for five-prime moduli
description: construct() -> a squarefree integer n in [2,1000000] with exactly five distinct prime factors. Maximize the longest cyclic run of residues not coprime to n. This score equals j(n)-1, not j(n); every residue and the wraparound gap are checked. The bounded five-factor search recovers a known finite case; Table 1 gives H(5)=14, so the local run-length score has a known upper bound of 13.

sources.locator: Lajos Hajdu and N. Saradha, Disproof of a conjecture of Jacobsthal (2012). Author-hosted full text, introduction and Theorem 1.2/Table 1 inspected. It defines H(r), proves H(5)=14, and distinguishes the longest bad run from j(n). The bounded five-factor search recovers a known finite case; Table 1 gives H(5)=14, so the local run-length score has a known upper bound of 13.
